definition.def: If someone or something enables you to do a particular thing, they give you the opportunity to do it.
examples: The new test should enable doctors to detect the disease early. [VERB noun to-infinitive]
...a new charter for training to enable young people to make the most of their potential. [VERB noun to-infinitive]

definition.def: To enable something to happen means to make it possible for it to happen.
examples: The hot sun enables the grapes to reach optimum ripeness. [VERB noun to-infinitive]
A series of holes in the side panels enables the position of the shelves to be adjusted. [VERB noun to-infinitive]
The working class is still too small to enable a successful socialist revolution. [VERB noun]

definition.def: To enable someone to do something means to give them permission or the right to do it.
examples: The republic's legislation enables young people to do a form of alternative service. [VERB noun to-infinitive]
